city-blocks.title: City Blocks - Free Online Match-3 Puzzle Game
city-blocks.slogan: Build Your Dream City with City Blocks
city-blocks.description: City Blocks is a captivating match-3 puzzle game where you merge buildings to create a thriving city. Strategize to maximize your population before running out of space. Each upgrade unlocks more space for inhabitants. Play City Blocks now and experience the joy of city-building!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: City Blocks is a match-3 puzzle game where you merge buildings to create a city. The aim is to build a city with the highest population possible before you run out of space.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Merge buildings to create new structures.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Strategize to maximize space and population.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Combine buildings to create new and more advanced structures.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Upgrade buildings to unlock more space and increase population.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Plan your moves carefully to maximize space and population.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Watch your city grow and thrive as you merge and upgrade buildings.
